title: Decide and plan: Kanbus/Auritus/Apricity legacy sites (Gatsby, Next export, Vite): retire after cut-over

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision: retire. The replacements are live on the standard front end (kanb.us, aurit.us, apricity.anth.us marketing; Apricity app moved to play.apricity.anth.us). Old resources kept only for rollback: Kanbus Amplify app d2h5foxy5ng19a (dist d2xpv7jaltlgoe.cloudfront.net) and staging.kanb.us record; Auritus Amplify app d1xec2o22j5yq2 (dist d11nqalufqzgfu.cloudfront.net); Apricity old apex association/CNAME to d2jjrpf0iybapo.cloudfront.net and the apex Cognito callback URL. Ryan deletes them after a quiet week (agents never delete apps/stacks).
